_comment: Answer overrides where the source key file is wrong (each verified by re-derivation + zoom-crop; the book's own printed solution agrees in every case). Content fix applied directly in questions.json (not an override): Q1394 stem restored to 'cos^-1 x + cos^-1 y = ?' (the printed stem mistakenly repeated 'sin^-1 x + sin^-1 y'; given sin^-1 x + sin^-1 y = pi/2, the answer pi/2 = key A).

1315.reason: key 'b' wrong: cos^-1 x + cos^-1 y + cos^-1 z + cos^-1 t = 4pi forces each = pi (max), so x=y=z=t=-1 and x^2+y^2+z^2+t^2 = 4 = option C

1357.reason: key 'b' wrong: sin^-1(sin 5pi/6) = pi/6 and tan^-1(tan pi/6) = pi/6, sum = pi/3 = option C

1366.reason: key 'b' wrong: tan^-1 2x + tan^-1 3x = pi/2 requires (2x)(3x)=1 -> 6x^2=1 -> x = 1/sqrt6 = option A

1367.reason: key 'c' wrong: 2 tan^-1(cos x) = tan^-1(2 cosec x) reduces to cos x = sin x -> x = pi/4 = option B
